subject: Deployment fails because of an error during installing package dependencies

messages.author: 2039e24dabab0203
messages.subject: Deployment fails because of an error during installing package dependencies
parts:
Hi,

when trying to deploy to shinyapps.io I get an error because one of the package dependencies keyring fails to build. Installing the suggested system libraries on the deployment server might help to resolve this issue.

Cheers,
Andrzej

[2018-06-09T22:58:52.565010529+0000] Building R package: keyring (1.0.0)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
* installing to library ‘/opt/R/3.5.0/lib/R/library’
* installing *source* package ‘keyring’ ...
** package ‘keyring’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
Could not find libsecret headers or libs.
On Ubuntu, you need to install libsecret-1-dev via apt.
On RedHat, Fedora, and CentOS, you need to install libsecret-devel via yum or dnf.
Note that in addition to libsecret, you either need pkg-config or set the
LIBSECRET_CFLAGS and LIBSECRET_LIBS environment variables.
ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘keyring’
* removing ‘/opt/R/3.5.0/lib/R/library/keyring’
################################# End Task Log #################################
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 530739488 failed: Error building image: Error building keyring (1.0.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted
